title: satureja lepida subsp. bolleana
intro: Satureja lepida subsp. bolleana, commonly known as Bolleana savory, is a subspecies of the Satureja lepida plant, a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to the Mediterranean region. Bolleana savory is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and neutralize free radicals in the body. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and improve cognitive function, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bolleana savory include volatile oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
